user.title: Connect Nourish Nutrition
user.description: Follow the [GitHub setup guide](https://github.com/ChadJPetersen/home-assistant-nourish#2-obtain-connection-details) to get your connection details, then paste the private JSON below. **Keep it secret:** the JSON includes a sensitive refresh token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Nourish Nutrition
reauth_confirm.description: Nourish rejected your saved session. To reconnect: (1) Sign in to Nourish in a separate browser profile. (2) Follow the [GitHub reauthentication instructions](https://github.com/ChadJPetersen/home-assistant-nourish#if-authentication-fails-home-assistant-repairs) and run the connection helper. (3) Paste the new private JSON below. (4) Submit to test and reconnect. **Never share tokens, cookies, or connection JSON.**

error.invalid_details: The connection details are missing or invalid.
error.invalid_auth: Nourish rejected the credentials. Sign in again and copy fresh details.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Nourish. Try again later.
error.different_account: These connection details belong to a different Nourish account.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Nourish Nutrition integration is supported.
